verdict.rationale: ByteAsk has no native scheduler. Its headless `byteask exec` subcommand is documented for scripting and CI pipelines: it runs one task to completion and exits, with JSON Lines output, schema-conformant final responses and sandbox controls. That makes it usable as a job step that an external cron or CI scheduler triggers on a recurring basis, so scheduling requires extra tools. Missing for 10: built-in recurring or scheduled job definitions, first-party workflow orchestration, documentation of cron or CI scheduling setups, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
